selection.quote: “Electric scooter” means a vehicle with handlebars and an electric motor that is designed to be ridden on in an upright or seated position and propelled by its electric motor or by propulsion provided by the rider.
selection.reason: The definition denotes a set of devices ridden on the road, limited by their build, weight and speed, which the ru.* classes can classify.
